motif.name: ATF3
brief: In mouse marginal zone B cells, ATF3 drives PDL1 expression, through which these cells restrain the T follicular helper response to a high-cholesterol diet.

motif.name: FOSL2::JUND(var.2)
brief: Fra-2 (FOSL2) drives IRF4 and Foxo1 transcription and is required for mouse B-cell proliferation and pre-B-cell differentiation.

motif.name: MNT
brief: Deleting Mnt in mouse T cells causes Th1-skewed hyperproliferation of activated CD4+ T cells, intestinal inflammation and T-cell lymphoma.

motif.name: CENPB
brief: CENP-B is a major anti-centromere autoantigen; antibodies to recombinant CENP-B were detected in 60% of patients with primary biliary cholangitis.

motif.name: POU3F1
brief: POU3F1 is one of the top five transcription factors predicted from disease-associated chromatin accessibility and gene expression in CD4+ T cells of SLE patients.

motif.name: TEF
brief: TEF is expressed in hematolymphoid progenitors, where it blocks apoptosis on IL-3 withdrawal and restrains proliferation by down-regulating the common beta chain of cytokine receptors.
